caption: The drawing features a repeating floral pattern on a gray background. The design includes two clusters of abstract flowers with petals and leaves, rendered in shades of cream, olive green, beige, and dark blue-gray. The flowers are connected by curving stems and branches with small leaves, extending across the surface in a sweeping motion from the lower right toward the upper left. Along the left edge of the drawing is a vertical beige border with a simplified leaf and vine motif in black, matching the curvilinear design of the flowers. The top edge also includes part of a vine in the same beige and dark blue-gray colors which curves into the main field. The composition is largely dominated by negative space, with the patterned elements appearing only in certain sections of the drawing.
title: Free Hand Decorated Wall
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
